method: Read-only bpy inspection of all 144 AC .blend files: non-hidden sparse member meshes/proxies, material diffuse colors and unlinked shader color inputs; additional P0 parent/outline and B03 neck-ring inspection. Hex colors are sRGB conversions. No rendering, generated outputs, or source mutations.
limits: A material inventory is not a pixel visibility annotation. Unlinked shader defaults can include irrelevant white; object names and specific shader inputs disambiguate conflicts. GT masks govern evaluation visibility. All source SHA256 values were recomputed and matched the transfer manifest.
